description: This file defines a 'Recipe' class along with an inner 'RecipeStep' class, encapsulating the structure and behavior for managing recipe data, including serialization to and from JSON and Android Bundles.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Main class representing a cooking recipe, including fields for title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps, with methods for JSON deserialization, Bundle serialization, and Bundle deserialization.

classes.name: Recipe.RecipeStep
classes.description: Inner class modeling a single step within a recipe, including text and optional image, with methods for converting to and from Bundle.

methods.name: Recipe.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Recipe object from a JSON representation, parsing title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps.

methods.name: Recipe.toBundle
methods.description: Serializes the Recipe object into an Android Bundle for inter-component data transfer.

methods.name: Recipe.fromBundle
methods.description: Constructs a Recipe object from an Android Bundle, restoring all fields including steps.

methods.name: RecipeStep.toBundle
methods.description: Converts a RecipeStep instance into a Bundle.

methods.name: RecipeStep.fromBundle
methods.description: Creates a RecipeStep instance from a Bundle.
